correspondence_assessment.six_holes_in8495: Six distinct pad-hole openings observed. Their positions within one image are usable as approximate image annotations.
correspondence_assessment.8494: Only two clearly localised right-side hole openings. One left pad face is visible without a reliable aperture centre; other expected holes are occluded/edge-on or unresolved. Do not supply six fabricated centres.
correspondence_assessment.why_none_certified: The two clear8494 apertures have no independently established station/handedness correspondence to8495 from these two views alone. Side silhouettes, pad planes and adjacent walls change projection and hide stations.

projection_limits.front_ellipse: One fitted conic leaves focal length, azimuth, pose, principal-point/crop and shape ambiguities. Occlusions also bias the aperture boundary; a good conic fit is not a full-image camera calibration.
projection_limits.pad_planes: The pad faces are spatially separated and visibly differently oriented. No common physical plane established; do not apply one planar homography to all six.
projection_limits.mm: No pixels/mm, hole diameter, wall thickness, mounting depth or lens focal length established.
projection_limits.owner_reported_residual: Owner reports40–50px misses in8494 after alignment to8495 under conic-based camera families. Not recomputed here and not assigned solely to bad geometry or bad camera.
projection_limits.reading_bound_not_geometry_tolerance: The±3/4/5px local annotation allowances do not cover misidentification, occlusion, wrong station, wrong handedness or camera ambiguity.

safe_next_use.now: Keep the six8495 points and two8494 observations in separate image-local sets, with masks/unknowns. One estimatedpad may be studied independently; no duplication justified by a forcedsix-point fit.
safe_next_use.before_camera_or_shape_fit: Establish at least one station and handedness correspondence from moulded-wall connectivity/asymmetric local details or an existing intermediateview; record alternatives rather than snapping to nearest expected point.
safe_next_use.reserved_check: If8495 is used to form a hypothesis, retain8494 as a separate check with explicit correspondence assumptions. Do not fit both points and then present them as untouched validation.
safe_next_use.future_geometry_change: Re-examine pose/identity/occlusion before changing the pad to absorb40–50px; no clipping/notch/mirror to hide an unresolved projection.
